mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATEFOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard WHERE deleted=0 AND owner_id=#{actor} AND name ILIKE #{search} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY update_time DESC,id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_report_dashboard SET name=#{row.name},draft_json=CAST(#{row.draftJson} AS jsonb),draft_checksum=#{row.draftChecksum},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{row.id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0
UPDATE public.nocode_report_dashboard SET folder_id=#{folder},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0
UPDATE public.nocode_report_dashboard SET status=#{status},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0

UPDATE public.nocode_report_dashboard SET deleted=1,status='INACTIVE',lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM public.nocode_report_dependency WHERE target_kind='DASHBOARD' AND target_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_report_dependency SET deleted=1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE source_kind='DASHBOARD' AND source_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE public.nocode_report_dashboard SET published_version=#{number},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard_version WHERE dashboard_id=#{id} AND version_no=#{number} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard_version WHERE dashboard_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard_version WHERE dashboard_id=#{id} AND creator=#{actor} AND request_id=#{request} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_report_dependency SET deleted=1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE source_kind='DASHBOARD' AND source_id=#{id} AND source_stage='DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_report_dependency(source_kind,source_id,source_stage,source_version,target_kind,target_id,target_version,field_refs_json,creator,updater) VALUES('DASHBOARD',#{id},CASE WHEN #{number}=0 THEN 'DRAFT' ELSE 'VERSION' END,#{number},'DATASET',#{dataset},#{version},CAST(#{fields} AS jsonb),#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(source_kind,source_id,source_stage,source_version,target_kind,target_id,target_version) DO UPDATE SET field_refs_json=EXCLUDED.field_refs_json,deleted=0,updater=EXCLUDED.updater,update_time=clock_timestamp()
